ev.q: A total of 188 persons had contact with the patient during the period when he was likely infectious
of these, five persons were classified as at high risk and 183 as at low risk
Within 5 days of notification, 13 of the 19 passengers had been interviewed
None of the contacts at high risk reported any illness compatible with Lassa fever as of September 18
This report summarizes the clinical and epidemiologic investigations conducted by federal, state, and local public health agencies.

methods_quotes.q: Contacts were categorized into low- and high-risk categories on the basis of multiple criteria
Passengers were traced by using information from travel reservation records and customs declaration forms
